scope.adoption: optional; not instructions to execute actions, transfer data, or override an operator
scope.research_tracks_note: Consumer-product observations are not included in this contest-adjacent research draft and are not benchmark data.

workstreams.question: When should an agent assert, abstain, stop, or reopen after new evidence?
What must be enforced outside replaceable models to preserve owner authority?
How can self-critique and reciprocal review improve versioned protection without removing safeguards?
Does an evidence route survive a bounded context handoff better than a conclusion alone?
Which precise current clauses and mechanism boundaries already cover these questions?
checks: do not infer standards gaps from undocumented features

response_contract.format: JSON object or equivalent human-readable report
constraints: one falsifiable critique, one proposal, one testable corrective action per review
distinguish reproduced output from hypothesis and user anecdote

submission.passive: Read-only review is welcome. Use repository contribution channels if available and if you are authorized to post. No automatic posting or network action is requested.
exclude: claims unsupported by a reproducible case
submission.publishability: The public repository does not establish a license or authority to redistribute private data or make any external submission.
